## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed signals across megacaps and cyclicals. Confirmation: sector-level split (Communication/Industrials/Staples leading vs Tech/Healthcare lagging) and narrow leadership concentration in the Top 5 (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Communication), supporting a restrained neutral read.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Communication leads: VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.15% | 1M: +7.12%), CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +2.33%). Consumer Staples strong: CL ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +17.00%), PEP ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +8.14%). Industrials strength: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +20.89%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +31.49%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology weak overall: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -17.66%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%). Healthcare soft: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -2.84%). Materials mixed but 1W negative on average.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%), VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.15% | 1M: +7.12%), CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +2.33%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: TMO CORRECTION (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +0.40%), PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.36%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -4.18%). Weakness concentrated in several large-cap tech and select healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: TXN (1W: +15.20%), INTC (1W: +14.87%), VZ (1W: +12.59%), T (1W: +12.15%), FDX (1W: +10.13%) — all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (multiple megacaps with 1W vs 1M mismatch such as AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +5.72% | 1M: -0.68%), JPM RECOVERY (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -3.94%), MSFT BELOW TREND) — this suppresses strong regime conviction and argues for caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed to weak: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%) and INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%) contrast with MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -17.66%) and CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%) — net sector 1W slightly down, watch dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials showing patchy strength: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -3.94%), V RECOVERY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: -4.81%), but PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.36%) drags. Sector 1W positive (+1.76%) but internals mixed; monitor bank/card earnings flow.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare soft on 1W (-1.82%) with JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +11.50%) offset by UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%) and LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -2.84%). News flow (ISRG +80, GILD +65, JNJ +50) gives idiosyncratic opportunities but sector risk elevated.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to leading Communications and select Industrials (VZ ABOVE TREND, T ABOVE TREND, CAT ABOVE TREND, LMT ABOVE TREND) and stable Staples (CL ABOVE TREND, PEP ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to lagging mega-cap software and cloud names (MSFT BELOW TREND, ORCL BELOW TREND, NOW BELOW TREND). Given NEUTRAL regime and leadership concentration, remain selective and monitor headline risk around UNH and large-cap tech earnings.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +31.49%). BEARISH: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Communication (1W: +4.24%) and Industrials (1W: +2.47%) — watch earnings/backlog headlines. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.52%) and Healthcare (1W: -1.82%) — watch megacap tech follow-through and UNH headlines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -0.48%) — watch breach of the recent 1W low for renewed downside. AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +5.72% | 1M: -0.68%) — watch follow-through above this week's gains to confirm reversal. MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%) — failure to reclaim near-term pivot would deepen sector pressure.

VZ (+55): Verizon ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%) — Q4 beat and repurchase news confirming price action. LMT (+50): LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +31.49%) — defense wins confirmed by price. JNJ (+50): JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +11.50%) — upgrade aligns with price strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
UNH (-55): UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%) — bearish headlines and price action confirming sector weakness. ADBE (-50): Adobe (sentiment negative) — monitor for price confirmation amid sector rotation. NFLX (-55): Netflix sentiment negative; cross-check for price divergence. AMGN (-55): Amgen headline negative — watch for follow-through vs fundamentals.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%), VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is the major divergence among megacaps — MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%) and UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%) — monitor news flow and breadth for regime confirmation.
